primaryTextChecks.text: The king of the children of Ammon answered the messengers of Jephthah, “Because Israel took away my land when he came up out of Egypt, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and to the Jordan. Now therefore restore that territory again peaceably.”

context.text: Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the children of Ammon, saying, “What do you have to do with me, that you have come to me to fight against my land?”
Jephthah sent messengers again to the king of the children of Ammon;

primaryTextChecks.text: They possessed all the border of the Amorites, from the Arnon even to the Jabbok, and from the wilderness even to the Jordan.

context.text: The LORD, the God of Israel, delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they struck them. So Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.
So now the LORD, the God of Israel, has dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and should you possess them?

geographicalEvidence.reasonJa: 現代のザルカ川に対応するとされるヨルダン東部の川。古代の境界用法は河道周辺を含む広がりを指しうる。

wikipediaRead.supportingParaphraseJa: 「Biblical Jabbok」節は、ヤボク川を現代のザルカ川と同定し、関連する谷や境界を説明しています。聖書に記された境界線が現代の河道と厳密に一致するとは限りません。

reuseCheck.detail: Exact target article/section was opened and relevant body text read; identity and location uncertainty are retained.

readerFieldRecheck.reasonJa: 11:22の境界範囲はknownBy11:13より後の節で初めて述べられるため常時表示からfactsへ。
内部編集用語を除き、記事が述べる同定と河川・境界の範囲差を読者向けに記述。

readerNoteRepair.changeReasonJa: 「プロフィールは川全域を一点化しない」という編集指示語を、現代河道と古代境界の位置関係に関する読者向け説明へ置換。
